The '''Battle of Lisebev''' was the decisive confrontation of Ledostrov's 1938 famine crisis.

== Background ==

The [[Duma of Ledostrov]] had failed to pass a budget for several years, worsening famine and political anger. The [[Burgrave of Sedava]], then duke, gathered peasant supporters and attempted to march on [[Novoanov]].

== Battle ==

The Ledostrov military, loyal to the Duma's noble faction, blocked the march. Under the [[Count of Litwaldov]], military forces defeated Sedava's untrained supporters. Sedava was captured.

== Aftermath ==

Sedava was executed for treason, and Litwaldov became duke. The battle did not solve the underlying crisis. Instead, it led to further repression, Litwaldov's short reign, and the 1942 succession breakdown that produced the [[Pentarchy of Ledostrov]].
